pages.label: Getting started
pages.summary: Start Pier on your computer in two lines, finish setup, add your first bins, items and team.

pages.label: Run Stall and Pantry beside Pier
pages.summary: Start the shop and the books apps next to Pier on your computer and connect them.

pages.label: Orders and dispatch
pages.summary: Take an order that reserves real stock, dispatch it in parts and bring returns back through quarantine.

pages.label: Sales channels
pages.summary: Connect stores, match existing listings, reserve incoming orders and publish stock after holds.

pages.label: Buy and receive
pages.summary: Keep supplier terms, approve the exact purchase order and receive what arrives into named bins.

pages.label: The warehouse floor
pages.summary: Receive by scanning, pick waves with a scan check per line, pack cartons and close the day's dispatch.

pages.label: Shipping labels and tracking
pages.summary: Review shipping addresses, compare carrier rates and buy carton labels through your EasyPost connection.

pages.label: Transfers and counts
pages.summary: Move stock between warehouses through transit, and count a bin without overwriting work in progress.

pages.label: Activity and proposals
pages.summary: Follow any quantity to the document, person and reason behind it, and review an agent's proposals.

pages.label: Books and reconciliation
pages.summary: Post to Pantry, bring payments back, review exceptions and export for your accountant.

pages.label: Scan a return
pages.summary: Restock inspected returns, quarantine damaged units or write them off and post the credit to Pantry.

pages.label: Item checks and AI setup
pages.summary: Check an item against saved stock, demand, receipts and sell-through, then review exact changes.

pages.label: Retail EDI
pages.summary: Receive retailer purchase orders, review acknowledgments, prepare carton ASNs and invoices, and print SSCC labels.

sections.title: Move in and keep it safe

pages.label: Switch inventory systems
pages.summary: Map Cin7 Core, inFlow or Fishbowl exports, compare independent bin totals and approve one reversible cutover.

pages.label: Moving in from CSV
pages.summary: Bring items, bins, opening stock and open orders from CSV files, reviewed before one cutover.

pages.label: Backup and restore
pages.summary: Keep a complete archive of your installation and restore it with the release that made it.

pages.label: Put Pier online
pages.summary: Deploy to your own Cloudflare account with your real owner address, back up and restore the hosted database, and remove it.
